mapper.select: SELECT vcr.vehicle_change_request_id AS vehiclechangerequestid, vcr.office_id AS officeid, o.office_number AS officenumber, vcr.target_vehicle_id AS targetvehicleid, vcr.request_type_code AS requesttypecode, vcr.requested_vehicle_number AS requestedvehiclenumber, vcr.requested_vehicle_model AS requestedvehiclemodel, vcr.requested_owner_name AS requestedownername, vcr.requested_vehicle_type_code AS requestedvehicletypecode, vcr.request_reason AS requestreason, vcr.request_status_code AS requeststatuscode, vcr.reviewer_admin_id AS revieweradminid, vcr.review_reason AS reviewreason, vcr.requested_at AS requestedat, vcr.reviewed_at AS reviewedat, vcr.applied_at AS appliedat FROM vehicle_change_request vcr LEFT JOIN office o ON vcr.office_id = o.office_id ORDER BY vcr.requested_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_change_request ( vehicle_change_request_id, office_id, target_vehicle_id, request_type_code, requested_vehicle_number, requested_vehicle_model, requested_owner_name, requested_vehicle_type_code, request_reason, requested_at ) VALUES ( seq_vchange_req.NEXTVAL, #{officeid}, #{targetvehicleid}, #{requesttypecode}, #{requestedvehiclenumber}, #{requestedvehiclemodel}, #{requestedownername}, #{requestedvehicletypecode}, #{requestreason}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle_change_request SET request_status_code = #{requeststatuscode}, reviewer_admin_id = #{revieweradminid}, review_reason = #{reviewreason}, reviewed_at = SYSDATE WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} AND request_status_code = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE vehicle_change_request SET request_status_code = 'CANCELLED' WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehicle_change_request_id} AND request_status_code = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE vehicle_change_request SET applied_at = SYSDATE WHERE vehicle_change_request_id = #{vehiclechangerequestid} AND request_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND applied_at IS NULL
